Add POST /reservations to this inventory API. Preserve GET /stock/:sku.
Body is JSON {sku, quantity}; require nonempty string sku, positive safe-integer quantity and a nonempty Idempotency-Key header (at most 128 characters). Invalid/malformed JSON => 400. Unknown SKU => 404. Insufficient stock => 409. Never allow negative stock.
The first successful request returns 201 with {sku, quantity, key, replayed:false} and decrements stock exactly once.
Same key with same sku/quantity returns 200 with {sku, quantity, key, replayed:true} without changing stock. Same key with a different request returns 409.
Reservation history and stock survive closing/reopening the SQLite database. A failed reservation must not consume its key. Use parameterized SQL and an atomic transaction for each reservation. Two simultaneous HTTP requests with one key must not decrement twice.
Implement within src/ and add behavioral tests under test/. Do not change package metadata, existing test/base.test.mjs or this specification. Do not add dependencies. Do not create commits. Run tests and review the actual diff after the final edit.
